claims.text: Up to a hundred and fifty an hour in a perfect sky, and the Moon sets before the show starts.

The Geminids peak on the night of 13 into 14 December 2026. The Moon sets at 20:04, so the sky is dark, and the radiant in Gemini is highest after midnight. Up to 150 meteors an hour is the ideal-sky rate (ZHR); from a town expect far fewer. Look south after midnight and let your eyes adapt for a few minutes.

Positions computed for central Europe (50°N, 15°E) with astronomy-engine; meteor rates from the International Meteor Organization. Narration uses a synthetic voice.
